ArtifactType.description: The artifact types a port can declare.

Param.description: A parameter an op accepts in a recipe step or on the command line.

choices.description: For a choice: the allowed strings.

default.description: The default when not required, as JSON.

length.description: For a number array: its length.

max.description: For a number or integer: the inclusive upper bound.

min.description: For a number or integer: the inclusive lower bound.

ParamKind.description: The value kinds a parameter can take.

oneOf.description: A fixed-length array of numbers; `length` says how many.
Two or more `[x, y]` points as fractions of the frame.
Any number of non-negative integers (indices); may be empty.
Any number of `[x0, y0, x1, y1]` boxes as fractions of the frame; may be empty.

Port.description: A typed input or output of an op.

many.description:
A port that takes any number of artifacts, named `<port>_<n>` from 0 (a finder's
instances); required means at least one. An output port of a finder, an input port of
an op over instances (`select`); a recipe binds a many input as `<port> = "<step>.<port>"`.

description: rascal's annotation block on a pack tool: what the copied manifest shape does not carry.

constants.description: The constant sets a step may select; the first is the default.

inputs.description: The input ports, by name: each is an argument taking an artifact id.

outputs.description:
The output ports; a `many` port takes the envelope's regions (a `Location` port) or
its images (an `Image` port) in order, named `<port>_<n>`.

params.description: The parameters, by name: each is an argument.
